Recovery preserves dirty and untracked state and uses ancestry-gated ff-only sync; hard reset remains forbidden.
Existing helper blocks duplicate or ambiguous canonical processes and never starts a second live runner.
Same task, attempt and continuation key remain bound; no duplicate task or commit stream is created.
Rows 30762, 46142 and 61522 remain mandatory and nearest-row fallback is disabled.
Configured DTM1m CoverageId must appear in GetCapabilities.
XML parser disables entity resolution and network access.
EA capabilities, description and raster bodies have a maximum byte limit.
GetCoverage rejects XML/error bodies and requires TIFF content type or magic bytes.
Values below -1e30 are excluded, covering the official finite NoData sentinel.
Sampling uses the exact HMLR polygon with pixel-centre mask semantics and no centroid promotion.
Three exact rows and three distinct Land Registry-INSPIRE IDs are required.
HMLR downloads restrict final hosts to the official service and approved object storage.
Authority ZIP and extracted GML/XML members receive SHA256 records.
Exactly one cleaned ID match is required before a polygon can be selected.
Resolver requests the required area and exact ASCII Grid/GML format before fallback.
Ambiguous Terrain50 download matches fail closed.
ZIP traversal, absolute paths and extraction collisions are rejected.
Nested depth, member size and total extraction bytes are bounded.
Current rounded max-minus-min must match preserved rounded span within configured tolerance.
Median elevation remains diagnostic and is not serialized as height difference.
4.15m and 8.30m linear RMSE-sum screens remain conservative non-confidence-interval checks.
Web acceptance probes are restricted to loopback HTTP port 8012.
Current local candidate payload requires a supplied SHA256 before web acceptance.
Operation numbers must be non-empty, unique, contiguous and count-matched.
Manifest file entries must be safe slot-local JSON basenames.
Promotion requires operator preflight, git snapshot, restart and final sampling receipts; current count is 0/4.
DescribeCoverage silently substitutes E,N when fewer than two axisLabels are observed.
GetCoverage neither requests nor records an interpolation method.
Sampler records raster resolution but does not require exactly 1m by 1m.
Output declares ODN without proving a vertical datum identifier from response metadata.
DescribeCoverage does not bind returned CoverageId/domainSet/axes to the selected coverage.
Returned bounds, transform, band count and range unit are not bound to the requested subset.
Crosschecker does not enforce 200x200, exact 50m, 10km bounds, companions or member hashes.
Multiple ASC/TXT files for one tile are concatenated and can overweight the median.
Seed URLs and filenames are not verified against the current catalogue.
GML/XML members are flattened to basename without collision rejection.
Examples and sources lack full semantic and identity uniqueness checks.
Resolver accepts direct download URLs and redirects without an approved final-host allowlist.
Area-only fallback can accept a generic ZIP without exact format/subformat proof.
Configured archive/root paths can pass without current OS API/version provenance.
Products/download JSON requests lack final-host, content-type, size and response-hash checks.
Numeric gate accepts --wcs-url and sampler follows redirects without binding requested/final host and path to the official EA endpoint.
Sampler rounds min/max to 0.001m before the guard recomputes and rounds span/delta, allowing sub-millimetre-to-millimetre drift to collapse.
Metric guard compares only max-minus-min; a common vertical offset in min, max and median can pass the span gate.
Current output copies preserved result_confidence_percent instead of recomputing confidence from current coverage, resolution, lineage and QA receipts.
Metric guard permits missing, malformed or repeated geotiff_sha256 values and does not bind three hashes to row-specific GetCoverage receipts.
Matcher silently transforms any declared source CRS to EPSG:27700 although the official package is natively BNG.
Matcher uses geometry.covers(point), so a point on the boundary is labelled point-inside.
Tile identity is inferred by a permissive filename regex and is not checked against raster bounds/xllcorner/yllcorner.
Crosschecker reads band 1 after only an EPSG check; band count, numeric dtype, rotation/skew and nodata header semantics are not fail-closed.
Loopback verifier has no response-size or content-type gates for index, manifest, operation, source and example responses.
Verifier computes child-file hashes but the manifest does not supply expected hashes, so current manifest identity does not cryptographically bind its children.
